successorWorkflowPolicy.policy: Post-R170 successor proof workflows may remain active only as read-only PR or isolated feature-branch authorities. Each must expose and pass a focused revision invariant. They may not schedule themselves, push-trigger on main, gain write permissions, recursively dispatch workflows, merge PRs, or directly mutate main.

historicalWorkflowArchive.policy: Superseded workflow YAML remains byte-preserved under .github/workflows-archive and remains independently addressable at the recorded pre-R170 source commit/tree, but is no longer an automatic GitHub Actions execution authority.
